Name: (CP) Trans Girl Sebastian (Viola)
Author: Zythalia
Description:
[size=3]She transitioned ^_^

This mod changes Sebastian's name to Viola, edits all game text to refer to her as she/her, and gives her feminine-looking portrait and overworld sprites.

You should be able to use this mod in conjunction with other dialogue expansion mods, but there may be occasional gender/name mismatches. In addition, I also split it into two halves so you can easily mix and match with other portrait mods :) It will also work fine with multiplayer [/size][size=3][size=4][b][u]


To Install:[/u][/b][/size][size=3]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then download this mod and extract the .zip into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.[/size]

The mod will unzip into two separate folders labelled "- Dialogue" and "- Sprites". If you would like to use this mod's dialogue changes with a different portrait mod, you can safely delete "- Sprites", or vice versa.


[/size][size=4][b][u]Config Options:
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]3 different hairstyles to choose from (long, ponytail, short)[/size]
[*][size=3]2 different all-season shirts (turtleneck, vanilla hoodie), as well as vanilla's biker jacket for winter, because it looks dope[/size]
[*][size=3]3 lip color options (gloss, dark purple, nude)[/size]
[*][size=3]Togglable cartilage piercing[/size]
[/list][size=3][u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][size=4][u][b]
Updates:
[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Overhauled sprites to appear more faithful to the character's personality, and added sprites for winter[/size]
[*][size=3]The game will consistently refer to the character as "Viola" and "she", [b]including within event dialogue.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Fixed Ginger Island portraits so Viola's shoulders aren't bafflingly wide (ConcernedApe also fixed this in vanilla 1.6)[/size]
[*][size=3]Viola now has both a wedding dress and a dress for the flower dance (although she does still stand in line with the men while dancing. If anyone has a suggestion for how to fix this, please let me know!) Edit: you may be able to use [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7089]Custom NPC Exclusions [/url]to make her not show up, but I haven't tested this yet[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]If you catch anything I missed, please make a post on the mod page and let me know 👍[/size]
